comment: Worked out by hand. Block: a 20 x 10 x 5 box, 1000. Lid: its top face 2 up (the parameter gap), 20 x 10 = 200 at z 7. Frame: a strip 3 wide continuing the top past its four edges, mitred: 26 x 16 - 20 x 10 = 216, at z 5. Walls: the walls of a 20 x 10 rectangle at x 40..60, 5 high, extended 2 (gap) past their top edges: 2 (20 + 10) 7 = 420.
